description: This PHP file defines the 'Setting' controller class within the OpenCart admin task namespace, responsible for generating and managing store settings, including tasks such as creating configuration files, retrieving store and localization data, and cleaning up generated files.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class handling store setting tasks in OpenCart's admin namespace, including generating configuration files, managing store data, and cleaning up generated files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of setting-related tasks for all stores and languages, including creating task entries and returning a success message.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Generates a JSON configuration file for a specific store, including store info, localization, theme, currency, and other settings.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated JSON configuration files for a store and language combination.
